faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.desc: Clear answers to the most common questions about BI-ALEM.

items.q: Can I register as a student or instructor?
items.a: Yes. You can register on BI-ALEM as a student or instructor depending on your needs. Students can enroll in courses and track progress, while instructors can create and publish courses for all students.

Courses are available at different prices. Instructors set course pricing, and discount coupons and seasonal offers are also available. Students can use the rewards and referral system to get discounts.

items.q: Are certificates available after course completion?
items.a: Yes. Students receive a verified digital certificate once they complete the course and meet the requirements. Each certificate includes a unique verification number and link, and can be shared on LinkedIn and elsewhere.

Instructors schedule live sessions in advance and set the date and time. Enrolled students receive a reminder before the session and can join through a private link. Meeting links are never shared publicly for security.

items.q: Can instructors upload courses on their own?
items.a: Yes. Instructors can independently create courses through the instructor dashboard. They can add sections, lessons, files, quizzes, and schedule live sessions with ease.
Yes. All courses are reviewed by the admin team before becoming available to students to ensure quality and platform standards. Review usually takes 1 to 3 business days.

items.q: Is there a rewards or referral system?
items.a: Yes. BI-ALEM includes a full rewards and referral system. You can share your referral code with friends to earn reward balance for course purchases. Periodic discount coupons are also available.
You can contact support through the support section inside your dashboard or by email at support@bialem.com. The support team is available throughout the week.
